query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x.id,'caseId',x.case_id,'caseTitle',c.title,'status',x.status,'summary',x.summary,'priority',x.priority,'assignedUserId',x.assigned_user_id,'version',x.version) ORDER BY x.updated_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM editorial.corrections x JOIN editorial.cases c ON c.id=x.case_id WHERE x.status IN ('DRAFT','REVIEW')
